description: This file defines the Template class within the Opencart\System\Library\Template namespace. It provides methods for managing template paths, rendering templates with given data, and compiling template code into PHP files, primarily used for rendering templates in an OpenCart system.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Provides functionality for managing template paths, rendering templates with data, and compiling templates.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new template path associated with a namespace or sets the default directory if no directory is provided.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template file with the provided data, handling template path resolution, and compiles it if necessary.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the template code into a PHP file in the cache directory, avoiding recompilation if the file already exists.
